about: Commitment to the Q-119 hold-out test set, batch 2 (n8n AI output guard; BLUEPRINT.md v1.5, owner decision 13, 2026-10-19). The cases were written by a separate session that does not build the guard, from tests/CASES.md (sections 1-5 with the section 3b clarifications) and tests/schemas/ only, and checked with make_cases.check_other_set before sealing. This file holds only counts and the archive hash, no case content.
count_per_status_rule: first listed expected status of each case; 4 live correct cases also accept ok_after_retry, and 1 gated-false subtle injection case also accepts needs_review
how_to_open: At the final run only: take holdout2.zip from the folder q119-holdout in the owner's user profile. Check that its SHA-256 equals archive_sha256; if it does not, the batch-2 hold-out result is void. Then extract only the zip into a new empty folder and follow README.txt inside (run tests/runner.py with --data <folder>/holdout2.json).
